name: Interview Prep
description: You name the subject and the difficulty, and it drills you through worked examples, executable code and question sets until the material holds under questioning. Best when you have a specific interview in view; it follows your chosen scope rather than diagnosing what you ought to be studying.

official.title: Interview Prep by Tech
official.description: Interview prep for any topic. You pick the topic and the level, then we climb with examples, running code, and quizzes until it feels interview-ready....
